findings.title: A hidden design becomes a public report
findings.claim: The focus calls the Yusuf narrative consequential news from the unseen: the addressee was absent when the brothers settled their affair and plotted. In the same pericope, the message asks no reward and is called a reminder for all (12:104), while the stories are presented as a lesson, confirmation, and non-fabricated account (12:111). The private design thus enters a public teaching account.
findings.mechanism: Information-bearing news and directed revelation bring the absent scene into contact with collective resolve and plotting. The linked context at 12:104 frames the message as an unpaid reminder; 12:111 gives the stories an instructional and truth-confirming use. This changes the macro role from disclosure of a missed meeting to a transmissible teaching account.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the private plan enter an account whose ending states how the narrated events may be received.
findings.containment: The plain report and the addressee's absence remain intact. This does not claim that the no-reward statement specifically targets the brothers' council or that hearers accept the account; it may establish messenger integrity alone.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches have accepted records and the 12:104/111 relations are explicit. Their synthesis as a public teaching account is a grounded macro inference, but its exact contrast with council secrecy remains interpretive.

findings.title: A carried trace crosses absence
findings.claim: Across 12:94-96, Yusuf's scent reaches Yaqub before visual reunion, and a garment carried back is followed by restored sight. Beside this sequence, 12:102's report of an event its addressee did not witness can be heard as a trace carried across separation, giving access to what was absent. This is a sensory analogy for disclosure's reach; the focus still says its recipient was not there.
findings.mechanism: HFT before: "Revelation carries propositions about an absent event." HFT after: "Revelation behaves like a carried trace of the absent event: it arrives across separation and re-enables perception without erasing the recipient's original absence." The focus presents directed news about an unseen event. Around it, scent travels ahead of encounter, a bearer brings an object, and sight returns when it is cast on Yaqub. These carriers make non-eyewitness disclosure newly legible as a trace-bearing arrival rather than an abstract proposition alone.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can picture how disclosure reaches someone who did not witness the scene through the pericope's move from scent to bearer to sight.
findings.containment: The focus's primary claim of absence remains unchanged. This is not literal scent or a claim that 12:94-96 explains 12:102; family recognition remains a live reading. HFT live alternative: The packet supplies a mobile scent-trace and restored sight; I infer an analogy from that sensory transport to revelatory transport. A live alternative is that 12:94-96 illustrates family recognition only and does not specify the epistemology of 12:102.

epistemic.reason: All eight HFT coordinates match supplied focus/context root occurrences. The source is legacy_unbound and the sensory-to-revelatory contact is inferential, so the analogy stays qualified.

findings.title: The account makes its order legible in hindsight
findings.claim: At 12:100, Yusuf identifies fulfillment of his earlier vision and describes divine action as subtle and wise; at 12:101 he speaks of interpretation. The focus's 'that' then names the preceding events as reports from the unseen. Together they permit a reading of an order that becomes legible retrospectively, not only disclosure of a private meeting.
findings.mechanism: HFT before: "The report exposes what conspirators privately decided." HFT after: "The report also reconstructs the latent order by which scattered events acquire a coherent outcome that the conspirators could not see." Fulfilled vision and realized correspondence at 12:100, with subtle action and ordered wisdom, supply context for the focus's unseen report. The transmissible account at 12:101 and the focus's backward-pointing demonstrative let the report gather earlier episodes by their outcome.
findings.reader_payoff: Earlier episodes become mutually legible through their fulfilled outcome.
findings.containment: The ordinary unseen-report claim remains intact. Subtlety may describe benevolence without asserting event-order; this does not claim participants consciously coordinated every event. HFT live alternative: The packet supplies fulfillment, subtlety, ordered wisdom, and reportable events; I infer that the focus disclosure reveals causal architecture as well as backstage facts. A live alternative is that subtlety marks benevolent kindness without implying a hidden event-order.

epistemic.reason: The focus and all six context coordinates match supplied Arabic/root occurrences. Retrospective coherence remains an attributed inference from a legacy_unbound source.

findings.title: Shared resolve does not certify a reading
findings.claim: The focus says the brothers jointly settled their affair, while 12:103 says most people will not believe, 12:105 shows people passing visible signs and turning aside, and 12:106 describes belief accompanied by association. Collective resolve and numerical prevalence can coexist with failed uptake; agreement alone cannot certify the council's course as sound.
findings.mechanism: HFT before: "Their unanimity mainly shows that the plot was efficiently coordinated." HFT after: "Their unanimity becomes an epistemic warning: agreement and prevalence can organize shared blindness just as effectively as shared action." The focus's collective decision meets later patterns of widespread unbelief, signs encountered without attention, and compromised belief. This turns unity from a sign of epistemic warrant into an example of how shared action or prevalence can organize error without proving truth.
findings.reader_payoff: The brothers' coordination reads as evidence of a shared plan, not evidence that the plan or a majority view is correct.
findings.containment: The later majority statements may concern reception rather than the brothers' decision procedure. This is a pericope analogy, not a claim that agreement is always false. HFT live alternative: The packet supplies unanimous plotting, majority unbelief, overlooked signs, and compromised belief; I infer a critique of consensus as evidence. A live alternative is that the later majority language concerns reception of the message without commenting on the earlier council's decision procedure.

epistemic.reason: All focus/context coordinates match supplied root occurrences and cues. Applying later counterexamples to the brothers' council is an inference from a legacy_unbound source.

findings.title: Available signs can become functionally unseen
findings.claim: The focus names an event outside the addressee's presence and knowledge. At 12:105 people pass visible signs and turn away; at 12:107 an enveloping event arrives while they do not perceive it. Thus what is unseen can also be a condition produced when available signs are not attended to, while the focus noun still refers to the absent event.
findings.mechanism: HFT before: "The unseen is what no ordinary observer could access because the event is absent." HFT after: "The unseen also diagnoses how observers make available signs absent to themselves through passing contact, active turning, and deficient awareness." The focus's hiddenness and directed disclosure meet sign-like indication, visible signs, active turning away, and sudden covering without awareness. The context expands unseeing from lack of access to a condition attention can also produce.
findings.reader_payoff: Disclosure of an inaccessible past sits beside a warning about present signs made inaccessible by inattention.
findings.containment: The focus does not lexically mean neglected signs, and the later warning may be distinct. The analogy does not collapse historical or metaphysical unseen into inattentiveness. HFT live alternative: The packet supplies visible signs ignored until an unperceived sudden event; I infer that contextual inattention is an analogue of the focus's non-presence. A live alternative is that ghayb remains specifically historical or metaphysical while 12:105-107 describes a separate moral failure.

epistemic.reason: Focus/context coordinates match supplied root occurrences and compact cues. Extending absence to inattention remains an attributed legacy_unbound inference.

findings.title: The report opens onto a way of inspection

The pericope names a way pursued with insight (12:108), urges travel and looking at outcomes (12:109), and calls the stories a lesson and detailed account (12:111). The focus report's supplied clear-road facet contacts the declared way and insight, travel and directed looking, and trace-following stories with lesson and detail. These carriers form a progression from receiving an account to inspecting consequences and carrying a lesson into another case.
findings.reader_payoff: Non-eyewitness disclosure is followed by an invitation to reason from histories and outcomes, not bare reception alone.
findings.containment: The route is an analogy, not a literal road or claim every report must be proven by travel. The exhortation at 12:109 may confirm rather than test the account. findings.title: The settled plot is not the whole sequence
findings.claim: The focus presents the brothers' affair as settled and plotted. At 12:110 the messengers pass through exhausted hope before help arrives, some are rescued, and the force is not turned back. The later sequence can make the human settlement one real but provisional phase within a larger course whose outcome exceeds the plotters' horizon.
findings.mechanism: HFT before: "The coordinated plot determines the affair it has settled." HFT after: "The coordinated plot determines only a provisional phase; the full affair includes an unseen counter-arrival beyond the plotters' temporal horizon." The focus's collected resolve and deliberative affair meet the later threshold of exhausted hope, arriving help, rescue, and denied repulsion. Their contact changes the scale of apparent closure: the focus reports a real plan, while the pericope's ending shows a longer sequence it does not contain.
findings.reader_payoff: An apparently closed human plan need not define the eventual narrative outcome.
findings.containment: The later passage concerns messengers and may state a general pattern rather than redescribe the brothers' council. The focus's report remains intact; the relation is attributed. HFT live alternative: The packet supplies human closure, exhausted expectation, arriving help, rescue, and non-repulsion; I infer that the latter sequence relativizes the plotters' horizon. A live alternative is that 12:110 states a general messenger pattern without directly redescribing the brothers' council.

epistemic.reason: Both focus and five 12:110 traces match supplied occurrences and cues. Connecting a messenger crisis to the brothers' plot remains a legacy_unbound analogy.

findings.title: An exploratory image of hidden causation
findings.claim: The focus word for the unseen has a supplied branch image of buried tree roots. Beside subtle action at 12:100 and stories traced into lessons at 12:111, this permits an exploratory analogy: visible events may connect through concealed generative relations traceable in their effects. This is an ecological model, not a lexical definition.
findings.mechanism: HFT before: "The unseen is an archive of facts hidden from the observer." HFT after: "As a contained ecological analogy, the unseen is a buried root-system of relations whose visible outcomes can be traced but whose generative links require disclosure." The exact buried-root branch supplies the carrier; subtle action gives a fine-grained hidden process and trace-following supplies a way to work backward from visible effects. Their contact pictures concealed relations whose outcomes can be followed.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader gains a bounded image for how outcomes may be disclosed while their generative links remain outside ordinary sight.
findings.containment: This is an ecological analogy. The focus does not lexically mean a root system, and the image does not prove a literal hidden mechanism behind every event. HFT source containment: This is cross-domain because it activates concealed tree roots as an image for ghayb. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is sharpened by contextual fineness and trace-following; downstream prose should mark it as an ecological analogy for latent causation, not as the lexical sense of the phrase.

epistemic.reason: The focus record supplies the buried-root image and both context coordinates match. The relation is a cross-domain analogy from a legacy_unbound exploratory nomination.

findings.title: The report travels as trace and route
findings.claim: The focus report reaches an addressee absent from its event. Yusuf's scent is recognized before encounter (12:94); later, a declared way with insight and travel toward outcomes appears (12:108-109). The pericope lets news be pictured as a mobile trace reaching the absent reader and a route toward surviving effects.
findings.mechanism: HFT before: "The report contains remote historical information." HFT after: "As a contained transport metaphor, the report is a mobile trace and a road: it reaches the absent reader, then teaches that reader how to travel toward the event's surviving effects." The focus's movement and clear-road facets of news meet distant scent, the path, and travel. Scent precedes encounter; path and travel give the trace direction toward outcomes. Remote information becomes a bounded transport metaphor through the narrative.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the account reaches beyond eyewitness presence and directs attention toward inspectable outcomes.
findings.containment: This is a transport metaphor, not literal scent or sensory residue. The scent scene may remain family recognition and the later path its own exhortation. HFT source containment: This is surprising because it combines the report's movement and road branches with scent, path, and travel into a quasi-spatial model. It remains anchored in the focus report and in the pericope's repeated carriers and routes; downstream prose should qualify it as a transport metaphor, not imply that revelation is literally sensory residue.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch records are supplied and all three context coordinates match root occurrences and cues. The transport image remains an attributed legacy_unbound analogy.
